completion_promises.evidence: Two seed runs attempted (.guardkit/autobuild/TASK-GR-SEED/logs/seed_run_{1,2}.log). Both failed: 25 writes scheduled, 0 succeeded, 22-25 'graphiti write failed' lines per run, 5+ 'abandoned at shutdown' per run, exit code 3 (EXIT_PENDING_WRITES_ABANDONED). Failure mode is NOT 401 AuthenticationError (the previous Wave-2 root cause has been eliminated by this turn's _CrossEncoderSentinel fix + falkordb driver install). New failure mode: vLLM at promaxgb10-41b1:9000 returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests for 63/74 requests in run-1 and similar in run-2. Root cause: seed dispatches all 25 episodes via fire-and-forget schedule_write (per CC-13 / ADR-ARCH-019 handler-budget contract), each episode's add_episode triggers ~3-4 internal LLM extraction calls, total ~75-100 concurrent vLLM requests overwhelms vLLM's queue cap. SEMAPHORE_LIMIT=2 env var only throttles graphiti-core's per-add_episode internal concurrency, not the seed's dispatch concurrency. Resolution requires either (a) seed-level batching (drain helper after each entity-type batch in seed_student_model.py), or (b) async_write.py adding a dispatch-layer semaphore. Both are out of scope for TASK-GR-SEED (verification wave); flag for a new TASK-GR-THROTTLE before re-attempting Wave 4.
